purpose: ten consecutive league rounds, one fresh teacher wave each
preregistered: 2026-08-25; primes fixed before any round ran
round_protocol: dispatch league-match: policy=learned, mode=challenge, model_run_id=<learning run>, challenger_name=pi{champion_generation+1}-pref-w{N}
on promotion: commit CI registry; always: append season log, update spectator room
integrity_notes: each challenger is trained on a strictly larger, preregistered corpus - never a reseeded retry on the same data
the frozen eval set never changes mid-season; switch threshold stays 0.5 all season

ten challenges against one frozen set carry residual multiple-testing risk; the rising champion bar and hard-head non-regression bound it, and the season verdict weighs the trajectory, not any single promotion
